sentence: The archive's Theophrastus line has assembled seven marks of such a signature — continuity of inquiry at a hinge written from inside; shared titles and a catalogue entry that declines to choose; a stylometric first axis that is operational, not nominal; one name spanning both voices; the minor corpus concentrated in the operations the major apparatus presupposes; the succession-story as the apparatus's own genealogy; reception asymmetry.[^8] The ghost catalogues are the eighth: *for the works the tradition files as lost under one name, the other name's catalogue supplies the naming rule and its corpus supplies the candidates, and the filing keeps the candidates from being seen as such.* And they were in Diogenes the whole time, in the first twenty lines of the one catalogue and the last thirty pages of the other.

title: What Syllogizing Can Divide: De anima III.5, the Divided Mind, and the Socket in God (EA-DIVISION-OF-GOD-01 v0.2)
sentence: Aristotle and Theophrastus are two persons: teacher and successor at the Lyceum, of different birthplaces and lifespans, with two wills in Diogenes Laertius, two biographies, and a public record that includes the Delphic decree honouring Aristotle and Callisthenes for the list of Pythian victors.

sentence: Themistius closes on the answer the corpus gives itself: πὼς μὲν δύο φύσεις τούτους τοὺς νοῦς, πὼς δὲ μίαν· ἓν γὰρ τὸ ἐξ ὕλης καὶ εἴδους, in one way these minds are two natures, in another one, for what is made of matter and form is one; and he sends the reader for the understanding of it to Ἀριστοτέλους καὶ Θεοφράστου, μᾶλλον δὲ ἴσως καὶ αὐτοῦ Πλάτωνος, Aristotle and Theophrastus, and perhaps rather to Plato himself.

sentence: (d) The prosecution and the law against the schools, DL V 37–38 (0.396–0.397): an impiety charge brought by Hagnonides, and Σοφοκλέους τοῦ Ἀμφικλείδου νόμον εἰσενεγκόντος, μηδένα τῶν φιλοσόφων σχολῆς ἀφηγεῖσθαι, ἂν μὴ τῇ βουλῇ καὶ τῷ δήμῳ δόξῃ, a law that no philosopher head a school without the council's and the people's consent, under which Theophrastus left the city καὶ οὗτος καὶ πάντες οἱ λοιποὶ φιλόσοφοι, he and all the other philosophers, returning the next year when the law was indicted as unconstitutional.

title: What Syllogizing Can Divide: De anima III.5, the Divided Mind, and the Socket in God (EA-DIVISION-OF-GOD-01 v0.2)
sentence: The production model of §§27–28 (one self-dividing maker; Theophrastus the first draft of the Aristotle position; Aristotle the legal identity) is the model the texts are consistent with and the one whose architecture III.5 states: one mind, a making part and a becoming part, related as a craft to its material; no evidence in the corpus requires a second maker, and the evidence offered for one is of a different kind from the texts it is offered against. v0.1 read III.5 as the Sappho line's technology "proposed, not demonstrated" at a third substrate. v0.2 locates the technology in III.5's own text (§12) and finds it operating on the corpus that transmits III.5.
